api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: Platform-issued Globo Ads Resultados token. Sent as a bare Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

cod_client.title: Client Code
cod_client.description: Globo Ads client code (codClient). SECOM is 258469.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Earliest date to pull /digital/items from, in YYYY-MM-DD. The API has no 90-day cap. Defaults to 2023-01-01.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Latest date to pull up to, in YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to sync up to yesterday America/Sao_Paulo. Never syncs today.

lookback_window_days.title: Lookback Window (days)
lookback_window_days.description: Days before the stored cursor to re-read on every incremental run, so Globo restatements replace the trailing window. Destination must be append; silver keeps the latest _airbyte_extracted_at per date.

window_in_days.title: Request Window (days)
window_in_days.description: Maximum number of days requested in one /digital/items POST. The API has no documented cap; 31 avoids gateway timeouts on historical backfill.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Spring page size for /digital/items. The extractor this connector replaces used 1000.

demographic_lookback_days.title: Demographic Lookback (days)
demographic_lookback_days.description: Only campaigns whose last /digital/items delivery is within this many days are queried for /digital/demographic. DAI-A is excluded regardless. Verified live window is ~190-220 days.
